description: Land Acquisition - Welabodawatta, Balapitiya D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels (Welabodawatta, Delgahawatta, and Maradanewatta) for road widening purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of the land lots, boundaries, and acquisition procedures. The content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
